from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information about a single paper extracted from the collection for citation analysis."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the current paper")
    cites_from_collection: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles from the *other* provided papers that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
